items.issue: The clip praises devotion without defining reciprocity, incompatibility, abuse, coercion or when leaving is appropriate.
items.disposition: Keep both claims on hold and do not turn the value statement into advice to stay in a harmful or one-sided relationship.

items.issue: Calling one person 'unique' can conflict with formal warnings that scarcity may be mislabelled as love.
items.disposition: Use only when uniqueness is an active, reciprocal commitment made despite alternatives; preserve the unresolved tension.
